channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Former Bangladesh Prime Minister and BNP chief, Khaleda Zia passes away at 80
item.description: According to a statement issued by the BNP, Khaleda Zia passed away at around 6 am at Evercare Hospital in Dhaka, where she had been undergoing treatment for more than a month.

item.title: Kannada TV Actress Nandini C.M. Dies by Suicide in Bengaluru
item.description: Television actress Nandini C.M., aged 26, who gained recognition for acting in several Kannada and Tamil serials, died by suicide.

item.title: Sharvari looks back at portraits of her ‘favourite people’ as 2025 comes to an end
item.description: As 2025 draws to a close, Sharvari has taken a moment to pause and look back at the people who ground her every day.

item.title: Silver, gold show sign of reversal after sharp retreat
item.description: Precious metals showed signs of reversal in domestic market on Tuesday after it retreated sharply, with gold and silver falling from record highs in the earlier session.

item.title: Indian national challenges US immigration detention
item.description: The order was issued on December 24 by the US District Court for the Southern District of California, which asked the government to respond to a habeas corpus petition filed by Naveen Naveen, an Indian citizen contesting the legal basis of his continued immigration detention.

item.title: PM Modi Holds Pre-Budget Talks with Economists, Experts Ahead of Budget 2026
item.description: Ahead of the Union Budget 2026-27, Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to meet top economists and experts on Tuesday to seek their views.

item.title: Measurement of Graveyard Near Sambhal Jama Masjid to Begin Today
item.description: The measurement of the eight-bigha graveyard located near the Jama Masjid in Uttar Pradesh's Sambhal is set to begin shortly on Tuesday.

item.title: Bengaluru demolition row: Pralhad Joshi slams Congress govt, calls relief to encroachers a ‘paradox’
item.description: Calling the move a paradox, the Union Minister objected to the state government’s announcement of financial assistance ranging from Rs 8 lakh to Rs 11 lakh per house, along with subsidies, for encroachers to rebuild homes, describing it as “one-time compensation”.

item.title: Trump Threatens Swift Action if Hamas Fails to Disarm
item.description: US President Donald Trump warned Hamas to disarm within a “very short period of time,” cautioned Iran against rebuilding military capabilities, and reaffirmed an exceptionally close US–Israel partnership.

item.title: Japan confirms season’s 1st bird flu outbreak in greater Tokyo area
item.description: Japan's agriculture ministry said on Tuesday that it has confirmed an outbreak of highly pathogenic avian influenza at a poultry farm in Saitama Prefecture, marking the country's 12th outbreak this season and the first case in the greater Tokyo area.
